attchmntText: PVP Ventures Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Evervie Health Limited, formerly PVP Ventures Limited, filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of extracts of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. The advertisements were published on November 14, 2026, in Business Standard and Makkal Kural. Gee Limited also approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 185.94 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Switching Technologies Limited announced a special window for shareholders to re-submit physical share transfer deeds pending since before April 1, 2019. This window is open from February 5, 2026, to February 4, 2027.

attchmntText: PVP Ventures Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
